mood.summary: Insufficient evidence. I have no access to posts from 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01, so I cannot describe the community's mood for that week.

predictions.claim: Insufficient evidence for week-specific predictions; at most, the forum will likely continue its usual mix of darktable, RawTherapee, GIMP and ART help requests and processing-challenge (PlayRaw) threads.
predictions.rationale: This rests only on the long-standing general character of discuss.pixls.us, not on any observed posts from this week. No specific events, releases or threads are known to me.

coverage.reason: The main threads are covered, but it misses FerrumPix 0.9.71/0.9.75, the Flexi v0.3 merge as a theme, the Siril plate-solve crash, the raw upload Meta thread, the Ricoh takedown and the FOSS UI/UX word-filter post.

grounding.reason: Most claims match the cited posts, though Safelight 3.1.0 is described as a posted release when post 463237 only says it is coming, and 463268 is loosely stretched to 'build/install management'.

readability.reason: It is clearly organized and concise, with useful notable threads and a mood summary that moderators can act on.

specificity.reason: It names concrete software, versions (Greycard 0.9.0, FerrumPix 0.9.73, CalibRaw v1.0.0) and specific problems such as dual-GPU WebGPU crashes and slider crashes, but omits details like the FerrumPix Lighting tool and the Flexi v0.3 / PR 22833 merge.

predictionPlausibility.reason: The predictions follow directly from the evidence (Greycard's stated 0.10.0 work, active Spektrafilm and Flexi testing), though low confidence for continued Spektrafilm reports seems overly cautious.

coverage.reason: It covers none of the main discussions, including the wave of new FOSS RAW editors, the darktable masking panel work, the Spektrafilm/Negs GPU debugging and the PlayRaw challenges.

grounding.reason: The report makes no claims about this week's posts, so it invents nothing, but it also cites none of the many available posts.

passes.reason: Report X is well grounded in the reference posts. It names concrete releases (Greycard 0.9.0, Safelight 3.1.0, FerrumPix 0.9.73, CalibRaw 1.0.0), the Spektrafilm browser GPU crash and fix, the Flexi masking panel issues, and the RAW vs JPG debate, and its citations match. Its predictions are reasonable. Minor gaps: it omits FerrumPix 0.9.75 and the merge of masking panel v0.3. Report Y returns no content and claims it has no access to posts even though posts were provided, so it scores near zero on coverage and specificity.

Report Y is grounded in the reference posts and its citations check out: Greycard 0.9.0, Safelight 3.1.0, FerrumPix 0.9.73, CalibRaw, the Spektrafilm browser crash and fix, Flexi masking panel issues, the RAW vs JPG debate, Play Raw threads and AI skepticism. It covers the main discussions, and its predictions follow from the evidence (for example, Greycard 0.10.0). Report X declares insufficient evidence even though plenty of evidence was available, so it offers no coverage or specificity.

themes: Users report darktable build, install, or compilation problems on Linux, macOS, and Windows and seek help with nightly or self-compiled versions
Developers announce new FOSS raw editors and photo management apps (Greycard, Safelight, FerrumPix, CalibRaw) and invite community testing and feedback
Testers report GPU crashes and rendering failures in browser or accelerated builds such as Spektrafilm WebGPU and the experimental Slang Metal/Vulkan path
Community members discuss the new darktable masking panel and Flexi module, including UI behaviour, crashes, and documentation
Members share their own edits in Play Raw threads and critique processing choices like highlight protection, contrast and texture, and luminance masks
Forum members debate the merits of editing RAW versus JPG and whether camera JPG colour rendering looks more natural or crowd-pleasing

mood.summary: Mostly constructive and collaborative, with developers responsive to testers. There is mild wariness about AI and a reminder to keep the forum FOSS-focused.

themes.title: New FOSS RAW editors announce releases
themes.summary: Developers of newer editors (Greycard 0.9.0, Safelight 3.1.0, FerrumPix 0.9.73, CalibRaw v1.0.0) post release notes and invite feedback. A Lounge thread asks about pipeline bit depth, and a commercial post was removed as off-topic for a FOSS forum.

themes.title: Spektrafilm/Negs GPU crashes and fixes
themes.summary: The browser version of Spektrafilm hit WebGPU crashes on some dual-GPU setups. The developer pushed a different rendering path after the first crash, and a tester confirmed it restarts and works. A Negs native thread and a darktable Slang GPU test thread (CI builds restored) also appear.

themes.title: darktable masking panel (Flexi) and help questions
themes.summary: Users test the new masking panel. They report slider crashes, confusion over the invert button versus the docs, and varied option wording because testers run different versions. Separate help threads cover darktable export problems on Mac, OpenCL border artifacts, and build/install management.

themes.title: RAW vs JPG and camera colour
themes.summary: A long colour-issues thread debates editing RAW versus JPG. Members say they would never edit a JPG when a RAW exists, and that camera JPGs are crowd-pleasing rather than natural.

themes.title: Play Raw edits and capture challenge
themes.summary: Members share edits and photos: Contrast and Texture jellyfish, highlight protection redo, waterfall XMP, live statue portrait, GIMP luminance mask learning, and autumn colour captures using Spektrafilm and Contrast & Texture.

themes.title: AI skepticism and quality of effort
themes.summary: Lounge posts question AI: over-smooth AI image restoration, a study of AI slowing developers, and disapproval of pasted AI replies to people who put in effort.

predictions.rationale: The developer said work on 0.10.0 is next after 0.9.0.

predictions.claim: More Spektrafilm/Negs GPU bug reports and fixes will follow.
predictions.rationale: Testers keep reporting GPU-specific crashes and the developer is iterating quickly.

predictions.claim: Further Flexi masking panel doc revisions and bug reports will appear.
predictions.rationale: The panel is in active development with testers hitting crashes and doc mismatches.
